summary: Edge-case corrections for complex row/column boundaries and grouped address/table layouts.

corrections.pattern: Address or row-group tables with merged cells have a low margin around left label columns; enforce row and column context before grouping.
Keep address blocks independent from label/value pair identity and preserve row group membership in semanticGroups.
Suppress question text and DI presentation text even when they overlap with fillable widgets at the page edge.
Use the same-row and same-column semantic label resolution for PDF widgets where adjacent label text is ambiguous.
